name: [UPD] Water Simulator: Flood Everything 🌊
desc:
🌊 The most realistic water on Roblox. Your own valley, your rules.

A whole valley where water behaves for real. It flows downhill, fills every hole you dig, floods the town and rushes down rivers. It's all yours to mess with!

💦 SPRAY water, lava, honey and slime
⛏️ DIG rivers, moats and canyons, and the water follows
🧱 BUILD mud walls, water slides, geysers and whirlpools
💥 BREAK THE DAM and watch the reservoir flood everything
🌋 ERUPT the volcano. Lava + water = rock!
🚤 RIDE boats, jet skis and a giant flamingo across the flood
🦆 DROP toys, rafts and bombs into the chaos

🌪️ Trigger huge events: a giant Tsunami, a Meteor Shower, a Mega Bomb, a Duck Storm!

😌 Relax and build, or cause total destruction. Nobody's stopping you.

🔄 Messed it all up? Hit Reset and start fresh.

⭐ Like the game to support updates!
